nodes.text: Postmenopausal bleeding + visible cervical exophytic mass: suspect invasive cervical carcinoma
Perform direct punch biopsy of cervical lesion; avoid Pap smear when visible mass is present

Preventive counseling: emphasize routine screening and HPV vaccination for eligible relatives
